name: Ashcombe Rovers FC
colorsNote: Green and white hoops with white shorts. Gold is the change strip, so pack both pairs of socks.
trainingNote: Every Wednesday, 7:00 PM, under the Rec floodlights — all season, whatever the weather.
kickoffNote: Boots on by 10:00 — warm-up starts 45 minutes before kick-off.
about: Ashcombe Rovers have played Sunday football on the Rec since 1978, when the Mill Lane social club needed somewhere to settle its arguments. Two open-age squads, one battered kit bag, and a post-match debrief at the Wheatsheaf that regularly runs longer than the match.
noticeboardNote: This page is the club noticeboard, not a live feed. The secretary updates the season file after every final whistle — no logins, no CMS, just one file and five minutes.

faqs.question: How do I join the club?
faqs.answer: Come along to Wednesday training at the Rec — 7:00 PM, no need to book — or email Pat, the club secretary, and you will get a friendly reply. New players train free for a month before match fees start.

faqs.question: What are the match fees?
faqs.answer: £5 a match, £3 for students and anyone between jobs, collected in the changing room before kick-off. Your first game is free. Fees cover referees, pitch hire, and the end-of-season presentation night.

faqs.question: Where is the ground?
faqs.answer: Ashcombe Recreation Ground on Mill Lane, Lower Ashcombe, AV12 4QP. Park by the pavilion and follow the hedge line — the far pitch is ours. The number 42 bus stops at the Mill Lane corner on Sunday mornings.

faqs.question: How up to date are the table and fixtures?
faqs.answer: This site is a static noticeboard, not a live feed. The secretary updates the season file after every final whistle, usually by Sunday teatime — if a score has not appeared yet, it is still being debated in the clubhouse.

faqs.question: Do I need to be good to get a game?
faqs.answer: No. We pick on turnout and effort, not trials. If you can make Sunday mornings, bring shin pads, and put up with the group chat, there is a shirt in the bag for you.
